verdict.rationale: A live probe found a structured llms.txt at help.pulley.com (HTTP 200) that indexes help-center articles by section. Several cited help articles are served as .md URLs, giving agents markdown-formatted docs to consume. Missing for 10: an llms-full.txt or bundled full-text export, agent-oriented coverage beyond the help center (the OpenAPI probe found nothing), first-party documentation describing agent use, and independent corroboration.
